text:
The plate looks about 20 cm across, so I treated it as a side plate. It holds one small slice of pizza topped with bacon and onion, plus a mound of white rice.

The pizza slice is about 11 cm long and 8 cm wide at its widest. At roughly 1 cm thick, I estimated it at about 65 g. I counted it as pizza at 270 kcal/100 g.

The rice covers about a quarter of the plate, roughly 9 by 8 cm, and is about 2 cm high. I estimated it at about 110 g, using the cooked-rice value of 130 kcal/100 g.

The bacon pieces on the pizza are already included in the pizza weight and calorie value, so I did not list them separately.
